findings.evidence: The declaration has only `{s : Set G}` and its statement applies `Subgroup.closure s`; unlike line 61, it has no subgroup argument.
findings.fix: Move it to `TauCeti` and update its two uses, choosing a conclusion-descriptive unqualified name.
findings.issue: `Subgroup.topologicalClosure_closure_eq_top_iff` is in the `Subgroup` namespace but takes only a `Set G`, not a `Subgroup G`, so it provides no `Subgroup` dot notation and violates the namespace rule.

findings.evidence: Mathlib uses `eq_of_eqOn_of_field_closure_eq_top` in `Algebra/Field/Subfield/Basic.lean:493` and `eq_of_eqOn_set_dense` in `Algebra/Ring/Subring/Basic.lean:887`; the naming guide reserves `.ext` for the structural pointwise-extensionality form.
findings.fix: Rename it to `monoidHom_eq_of_eqOn_of_topologicalClosure_closure_eq_top` or an equally concise conclusion-first `eq_of_eqOn` name.
findings.issue: `monoidHom_ext_of_topologicalClosure_closure_eq_top` uses `ext` for a conditional equality theorem instead of the standard `eq_of_eqOn_of_…` terminology.

summary: Two declarations use misleading namespace or structural-lemma naming.
